description:
The **Featured Card** is a **functional** web template designed to display a highlighted card on your site. Its purpose is to present a customizable title and control the number of items shown per row, making it ideal for featured content sections. The template pulls data from two tables – **account** and **contact** – allowing you to surface information from either source.

When configuring the template, you can adjust three editable parameters. The **Card Title** (id = *title*) sets the heading that appears on the card and is described as “The title displayed on the card.” The **Items per Row** (id = *itemsPerRow*) determines how many items are shown in each horizontal line, with the tooltip “Number of items to show in each row.” Finally, the **Source Table** (id = *sourceTable*) lets you select which of the available tables (account or contact) provides the data, and it is designated as a table‑type property.
